import hashlib, json, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
source = pathlib.Path('products/services/sqlite-repair/local-delivery/package')
names = ('README.md', 'diagnose.py', 'example-case.json')
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as work:
    clean = pathlib.Path(work)
    hashes = {}
    for name in names:
        target = clean / name
        shutil.copyfile(source / name, target)
        hashes[name] = hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    command = [sys.executable, 'diagnose.py', 'example-case.json']
    run = subprocess.run(command, cwd=clean, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
    report = {'command': command, 'python_version': sys.version.split()[0], 'sha256': hashes, 'exit_code': run.returncode, 'stdout': run.stdout, 'stderr': run.stderr, 'scope': 'Clean-directory execution of the existing staged package on its synthetic example. Inspect the returned report before claiming semantic success. Checkout, redistribution rights, sales and settlement require separate evidence.'}
output = pathlib.Path('products/services/existing-package-marketplace-checkout/sqlite-package-execution.json')
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
